title: OpenAI announces strategic collaboration with Japan’s Digital Agency
summary: OpenAI and Japan’s Digital Agency partner to advance generative AI in public services, support international AI governance, and promote safe, trustworthy AI adoption worldwide.
body: OpenAI and Japan’s Digital Agency partner to advance generative AI in public services, support international AI governance, and promote safe, trustworthy AI adoption worldwide.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布与日本数字厅建立战略合作伙伴关系，旨在将生成式AI技术引入公共服务领域。双方的合作重点还包括支持国际AI治理体系建设，并在全球范围内推广安全、可靠的AI技术普及与应用。
